content.value: Suppose a URP, KUET graduate has two job options: (i) stay in Khulna and do (20 freelancing; and (ii) go Dhaka and take up a job in a GIS firm. Considering per month standard living expense 10,000 BDT in Khulna and 15,000 BDT in Dhaka, explain his/her location choice based on the following condition.

content.value: (i) Explain the ideal location choice of the graduate.
(ii) (ii) In practice, what decision does the graduate make and why?
